Auth Dialog w/ SkillsCompound

FCC-AdminX connect-consent modal, skills generation (640px, radius 24, 40/32 padding). Partner logo + name + close, a description, a Skills row of “/skill” pills capped to 2 rows with a “+N” overflow pill, a 3-column meta row (Developed by · Category · More info), and a “Continue to {Partner}” button. User-sync sources add a Continuous-sync note and an Organisation’s Workspace URL input, and relabel the meta column “Links”. Skills match the source’s Settings L2 list one-to-one.

Usage

When to use. The connect-consent modal shown before a third-party source is authorized. The Skills section previews the "/skill" procedures the source will expose — capped to 2 rows with a "+N" pill so the dialog stays compact; the source’s Settings L2 lists the same skills in full. User-sync sources add a Continuous-sync note and an Organisation’s Workspace URL input; their meta column is labelled "Links". The primary action always names the destination: "Continue to {Partner}".
